title: Harissa Fish with Bulgur Salad
description: Spiced pan-fried cod with a herby bulgur wheat salad of cucumber, tomatoes and olives.
ingredients: 2x120 g skinless white fish fillets (cod or haddock)
steps: Cook the bulgur, then toss with cucumber, tomatoes, olives and parsley.
Mix the harissa, honey, garlic, lemon juice and a little oil into a sauce.
Fry the red onion, season and cook the fish, then pour in the harissa sauce to glaze.

source.label: Adapted from BBC Good Food harissa fish with bulgur salad

notes: A genuinely quick midweek dinner — the harissa sauce comes together in the same pan as the fish.
